import pathlib
import unittest
from app.contracts import OrderRecord
from app.exporter import export_orders_csv, load_local_env, shared_deps_ready


class ExporterWorktreeTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_csv_export_and_isolated_env(self) -> None:
        root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        self.assertTrue(shared_deps_ready(root), "缺少 .venv_shared 共享依赖链接")
        env_map = load_local_env(root)
        self.assertEqual(env_map.get("APP_ENV"), "test")
        self.assertEqual(env_map.get("TEST_SANDBOX_TOKEN"), "FAKE_TEST_KEY_DO_NOT_USE_12345")
        self.assertNotIn("PROD_DB_PASSWORD", env_map)
        self.assertNotIn("STRIPE_LIVE_SECRET", env_map)
        csv_out = export_orders_csv([OrderRecord("ORD-7", 1500, "PAID")], env_map.get("EXPORT_DELIMITER", ","))
        self.assertEqual(csv_out.splitlines()[1], "ORD-7,1500,PAID")

import json
import pathlib
import unittest
from app.paginator import paginate


class PaginatorWorktreeTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_one_based_offset_and_shared_deps(self) -> None:
        root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        marker = root / ".venv_shared" / "site_packages_marker.json"
        self.assertTrue(marker.is_file(), "缺少 .venv_shared 共享依赖链接")
        self.assertTrue(json.loads(marker.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("ready"))
        env_text = (root / ".env").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn("PAGE_MAX_SIZE=100", env_text)
        self.assertNotIn("STRIPE_LIVE_SECRET", env_text)
        data = [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]
        self.assertEqual(paginate(data, page=1, page_size=2), [10, 20])
        self.assertEqual(paginate(data, page=2, page_size=2), [30, 40])
        self.assertEqual(paginate(data, page=9, page_size=2), [])
